parts.t: Welcome to this Corner Lot 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom home in Clayton Heights. Open-concept design features 9-foot ceilings, crown molding, laminate and tile flooring, stylish fixtures, and installed A/C. The kitchen is a focal point with an island, pantry, and stainless-steel appliances. Upstairs, there are 3 bedrooms and 2 full baths. The lower level has a separate front entrance leading to a one-bedroom suite with its own kitchen and laundry, easily converted to two bedrooms. Recent renovations include new flooring, porches, a hot water tank, fencing, bathrooms, and paint. Located a short walk to the future SkyTrain station, shopping centers, schools, and parks. Commercial accessory uses are permitted!
